## Best available for group portraits

Select **Posed group** and open **Best available** on a burst. Compare the two
leading frames, read why one edged ahead, and inspect the relevant faces side
by side. Pick either frame. Close calls remain available for manual review.
All analysis and image display run on your Mac.

## Install

1. Download **OpenCull-…-macOS.dmg** below. It is one universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 14 Sonoma or newer.
2. Open the DMG and drag **OpenCull** onto **Applications**.
3. The first time you open it: OpenCull is free and not notarized by Apple, so macOS blocks a normal double-click.
   - Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway** next to OpenCull, or
   - on macOS 14, Control-click OpenCull in Applications and choose **Open**.

Everything runs on your Mac: no account, no uploads, no API keys.

## Quick start

- Open a folder of photos (⌘O) or import from Files, Apple Photos or Google Photos downloads.
- **Hold Space** or press **⌘K** to open the aperture menu: Import, Cull, Compare, Edit, Accept suggestions and Album actions.
- P / X / U pick, reject or clear; 1–5 set stars; ⌘Z undoes.

`opencull-cli` is the optional command-line analyzer, and `release-verification.txt` lists the checks and SHA-256 checksums for this build.
